distribution_model.detail: Sells beer through distributors and retailers; some products distributed or brewed under license in certain countries.

market_position.detail: Core power brands like Coors Light and Miller Lite, plus above-premium and value tiers.

notes: Distribution model draws on the distributor convention line and general knowledge of three-tier beer distribution.

product_category.detail: Beer, flavored beverages, hard seltzer, spirits and non-alcoholic beverages.

purchase_frequency.detail: Beer bought regularly for social occasions and everyday consumption.

sub_sector.value: global beer brewing; hard seltzer and flavored beverages; non-alcoholic beverages
